## History

Shirley was born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), before becoming an orphan as a child. She endured years of hard labor under the care of Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) prior to being placed in an asylum.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Quotes

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> “I’m going back to school,” she announced. “That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> “I think he has only been its nominal head for many years,” said Anne. “He is a very old man; his nephews are really at the head of the institution.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035)

> “If I had been the boy you sent for,” said Anne wistfully, “I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

> "Oh, Diana, will you promise faithfully never to forget me, the friend of your youth, no matter what dearer friends may caress thee?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Shirley maintains an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after returning to school following her forced estrangement from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). At the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) commencement, Shirley wins the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) earns the medal. Although their scholastic competition continues through their time at Queen's, Shirley later learns that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) plans to teach rather than attend college.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +5 more_
